verdict.rationale: The Entity Management API docs list a separate 'api-alpha.sam.gov' endpoint, which suggests a non-production (alpha) environment alongside the production API. The pack never describes it as a sandbox, never says its data is test data, and never explains how it is isolated from production, so support rests on one thin URL mention. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the alpha environment is a test sandbox, confirmation that it uses non-production data, instructions for getting alpha API keys or accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
